paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Comparison of the Improvement for 5-digit and 6-digit multiplication with as feedback model
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy improvement percentage over iterations for two different digit lengths, 5-digit and 6-digit multiplication. The x-axis represents the iteration number, displaying a linear scale from 0 to 9 with tick labels spaced by one unit. The y-axis represents the accuracy improvement percentage, ranging from approximately 0% to 70%, with tick labels spaced by 10%. The blue line, representing the 6-digit multiplication, begins at approximately 10% at iteration 0 and increases to approximately 70% at iteration 9. The orange line, representing the 5-digit multiplication, begins at approximately 5% at iteration 0 and increases to approximately 60% at iteration 9.
